scope: Grammar source completeness, lessons144→001. Audit performed before course/audio modifications.
source: pdf/新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf
method: Local Apple Vision OCR of all423 exercise pages and142 answer pages; bidirectional text coverage screening against all144 HTML grammar sections; manual review of flagged sections and source scans. Table/dialogue context and original task type included.
limitations: OCR-assisted completeness audit is not a claim of manual visual review of every page, exhaustive correctness of every preexisting answer, or subjective listening validation. New/repaired answers must be checked against source keys before publication.
